title: Marketing / landing page
description: Single- or few-page marketing site where design quality is the product.

steps.title: Brief
steps.acceptance: Goal, audience, single conversion action, copy source, brand assets, deadline and repo are written in the task brief.

steps.title: Art direction
steps.acceptance: One written direction: references, type pair, palette with contrast ratios, motion language, one signature idea. No generic gradient-and-cards look.

steps.title: Spec
steps.acceptance: Section list with purpose of each section, layout at 1440 and 390, copy, states, motion timeline, asset list.

steps.title: Build
steps.acceptance: Implements the spec on the default stack; Lighthouse performance >= 90 mobile, no layout shift, reduced-motion respected.

steps.title: Code review
steps.acceptance: Diff matches the spec and scope; no dead code; accessibility basics (landmarks, alt, focus, contrast >= 4.5:1).

steps.title: Visual gate
steps.acceptance: Screenshots at 1440 and 390 score >= 8.5/10 against the art direction and the anti-slop rules. Below 8.5 returns to build.

steps.title: QA
steps.acceptance: Playwright run at 1440/390: CTA works, forms validate, no console errors, links resolve, keyboard navigation works.

security_rules: No secrets, tokens or `.env` content in code, commits, logs or screenshots.
Dependencies: pin versions, run the audit (`npm audit --omit=dev`), no new package without a stated reason.
Forms: server-side validation, rate limit, honeypot or captcha, no PII in logs.
Third-party scripts (analytics, fonts, embeds) only from an allow-list; set CSP and `rel=noopener` on external links.
No inline secrets in client bundles; only `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` values are public by design.
Security headers set: CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy.
User-supplied HTML is never rendered unsanitised.
tech_stack: GSAP + Lenis for scroll and motion (respect prefers-reduced-motion)
React Three Fiber only when 3D is the signature idea, lazy-loaded
next/image and next/font; no layout-shifting assets

Anti-slop rules: No purple-to-blue gradient hero, no stock three-card feature grid as the main structure.
No emoji as icons, no generic 'Revolutionize your workflow' copy; copy names a concrete benefit.
Maximum two typefaces, a real type scale, one accent colour used with intent.
Every section has a purpose that can be stated in one sentence; delete the ones that do not.
Motion supports meaning (reveal, focus, feedback); no decorative parallax everywhere.
Real or art-directed imagery; no default placeholder illustrations.
Spacing follows a scale; alignment is verified at 1440 and 390, not assumed.
